paite: Gamdai leh phaksap gam a kipan dinga; gam keuin nuamsain pawn pak bangin a pak ding.
english: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

paite: A pak lun dinga, kipak tak leh lasain nuam a sa ding; Lebanon thupi na a kiangah piak ahi ding, Karmel leh Sharon kilawmna toh; TOUPA thupina a mu ding ua, i Pathian kilawmna toh.
english: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory Lebanon will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see Yahweh’s glory, the excellence of our God.

paite: Khut hatloute hatsak unla, khuk jawte kipsak un.
english: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble knees.

paite: Lungtang dawilokte kiangah, Hat takin om unla, lau kei un; ngai un, na Pathian uh phulakna toh a hongpai dinga, a honhondam ding, chi un.
english: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong. Don’t be afraid. Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

paite: Huai hun chiangin mittote mit hahsakin a om dinga bengngongte bil hihvakin a om ding.
english: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

paite: Huai hun chiangin khebaite sakhi bangin a tawm ding ua, pautheiloute leiin nuamsa takin la a sa ding; gamdai ahte lah tuite a hongphul khe biabia sin ngala, gam keute ah luita tui a hong phulkhe buabua sin ngal ua.
english: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

paite: Huchiin piaunel sa mahmah munte dil a hongsuak dinga, lei dangtak mahmah tuinak a hongsuak ding; sehalte tennaa, a lupna uah, loupa, tuilou leh sikhapat toh, a om ding.
english: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

paite: Huan, huailaiah lamlian a om ding, kongpi toh, huai tuh siangthouna Lampi a chi ding uh; mi thanghuaiin lampi a tawn kei ding; ahihbangin huai mite adingin ahi zo ding; mi vialzinte, ahi, mi haite leng, huailaiah a mang kei ding uh.
english: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called The Holy Way. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools will not go there.

paite: Humpinelkai himhim huailaiah a om kei dinga, sa hing ne himhim huailaiah a pai tou sam kei ding uh, huailah muh ding leng a om kei ding; tatte bel huailaiah a pai tou ding uh;Huan TOUPA tatte a kik nawn ding ua, lasa khawmin Zion a tung ding uh, khantawna kipahna a lu tunguah a omta dinga; nuamsakna leh kipahna leh thumna a mangta ding hi.
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

paite: Huan TOUPA tatte a kik nawn ding ua, lasa khawmin Zion a tung ding uh, khantawna kipahna a lu tunguah a omta dinga; nuamsakna leh kipahna leh thumna a mangta ding hi.
english: The Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
